name: Zheneng Jinjiang Environment Holding Company Limited
summary: Zheneng Jinjiang Environment Holding Company Limited engages in the generation and sale of electricity and steam in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Waste-To-Energy Project Construction and Operation; and Project Technical and Management Service, Equipment Selection and Sale, and EMC Business segments. It is involved in the operation of waste-to-energy plants; project management, technical consulting, and advisory services and energy management, as well as contracting business; and construction services under service concession arrangement.
